question: What claim is being made about the authority by which the yoginī named Wish is established up to the end of Māyā?
premises: The yoginī named Wish is established.
This is done by the siddhas.
It is done by supreme wish, extending up to the end of Māyā.
inference: The yoginī named Wish is established by the siddhas through supreme wish, up to the end of Māyā.
uncertainties: The precise ontological extent of 'up to the end of Māyā' is not specified here.
plain_english: The yoginī named Wish is established by the siddhas, up to the end of Māyā, by supreme wish.
